services.desc: Explore our charter options and choose the trip that fits your experience, interests, and ideal day on the Carolina waters. Experience our premier full-day inshore fishing trip, giving you plenty of time to work multiple hotspots throughout the inlet and even venture out to select nearshore/offshore reefs. This extended charter is perfect for anglers looking to maximize their chances at a trophy catch.You’ll have the opportunity to target a wide range of popular species, including flounder, redfish, speckled trout, black drum, Spanish mackerel, king mackerel, cobia, and various shark species-depending on the season and conditions.
